scope: Exactly two existing weekly image contexts.

images.captionJa: 過去の災害記録を使う前に、対象期間と集計範囲を確かめる教材例。画像は具体的な事故件数や現在の発生率を示しません。
images.observation: Adults consult archived binders and a separate current folder. Blank spines avoid invented year, denominator or accident figures; no historical count is represented as a current rate.
images.method: Actual full image pixels viewed; exact Japanese cluster and independent full source page text and renders reviewed.

images.captionJa: 現場内の確認と、現場外の道路移動の計画を分けて確認する教材例。車両は停止中で、運転や安全点検の手順を示しません。
images.observation: Stationary van remains inside the site gate while adults discuss paperwork and the road beyond. Onsite work and public-road travel are spatially distinct; no maneuver or traffic-clearance instruction is shown.
images.method: Actual full image pixels viewed; exact Japanese cluster and independent full source page text and renders reviewed.
